Looking at the optimized code, I can see that it correctly applies Strategy 1 by eliminating redundant computations. However, there's a critical issue with the accumulator memory constraints that needs to be addressed.

The original code uses `SPAD_DEST` as the destination address for both matrix multiplications, but according to the hardware architecture, the accumulator has limited capacity and we need to ensure proper management of accumulator space. Let me analyze and fix this:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MHA kernel (S=64, D=64, H=4, H_kv=4, causal=1, fp8:e4m3).
void solution(void) {
  // ---- 1) Hoist global configurations and loop-invariants (Strategy 1) ----
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  // Pre-calculate loop-invariant tiling bounds and spad base addresses
  // For Q @ K^T: Q is S x D, KT is D x S -> Output is S x S
  const int q_kt_tiles_I = ATT_S / DIM;
  const int q_kt_tiles_J = ATT_S / DIM;
  const int q_kt_tiles_K = ATT_D / DIM;
  const uint32_t q_kt_a_base = 0;
  const uint32_t q_kt_b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - q_kt_tiles_K * q_kt_tiles_J * DIM;

  // For P @ V: P is S x S, V is S x D -> Output is S x D
  const int p_v_tiles_I = ATT_S / DIM;
  const int p_v_tiles_J = ATT_D / DIM;
  const int p_v_tiles_K = ATT_S / DIM;
  const uint32_t p_v_a_base = 0;
  const uint32_t p_v_b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - p_v_tiles_K * p_v_tiles_J * DIM;

  // Use different accumulator destinations to avoid conflicts
  const uint32_t q_kt_dest = SPAD_DEST;
  const uint32_t p_v_dest = SPAD_DEST + (q_kt_tiles_I * q_kt_tiles_J * DIM); // Offset for second matmul

  for (int h = 0; h < ATT_H; h++) {
    int kv = h / (ATT_H / ATT_HKV);
    const elem_t *Q_in = Qs[h];  const uint8_t *Q_sc = Qss[h];
    const elem_t *KT_in = KTs[kv]; const uint8_t *KT_sc = KTss[kv];
    const elem_t *V_in = Vs[kv];  const uint8_t *V_sc = Vss[kv];

    // ---- 2) S1 = Q @ K^T on Gemmini (bf16 out) ----
    {
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)Q_sc, QSS_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)KT_sc, QSS_BYTES, 1);
      
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < q_kt_tiles_I; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < q_kt_tiles_K; k += 2) { 
          int bb = (q_kt_tiles_K - k < 2) ? (q_kt_tiles_K - k) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)Q_in) + i * DIM * ATT_D + k * DIM),
                                q_kt_a_base + (i * q_kt_tiles_K + k) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM); 
        }
      }
      
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t));   // B=KT[D][S] stride N=S -> slot (k*tiles_J+j)
      for (int k = 0; k < q_kt_tiles_K; k++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < q_kt_tiles_J; j += 2) { 
          int bb = (q_kt_tiles_J - j < 2) ? (q_kt_tiles_J - j) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)KT_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_S + j * DIM),
                                q_kt_b_base + (k * q_kt_tiles_J + j) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM); 
        }
      }
      
      gemmini_config_st(S_OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, q_kt_tiles_I, q_kt_tiles_J, q_kt_tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(q_kt_tiles_I, q_kt_tiles_J, q_kt_tiles_K, 0, 0, 0, q_kt_a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                           q_kt_dest, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
      gemmini_mx_read_smem(&S1_hw[0][0], q_kt_dest * 16, ATT_S * ATT_S);
      gemmini_fence();
    }

    // ---- 3) FLOAT-FREE integer softmax + fp8 requant (I-BERT iexp; host has no FPU) ----
    for (int i = 0; i < ATT_S; i++) {
      int64_t q[ATT_S];
      int64_t mq = -((int64_t)1 << 62);
      for (int j = 0; j < ATT_S; j += 4) {                       // unpack 4 bf16/word -> Q(1/1024) int + max
        uint64_t w = S1_hw[i][j / 4];
        for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
#if ATT_CAUSAL
          if (j + l > i) { q[j + l] = -((int64_t)1 << 62); continue; }   // causal: future col -> iexp()=0
#endif
          int64_t qq = mx_ibf16_to_q((uint16_t)((w >> (l * 16)) & 0xFFFF));
          q[j + l] = qq; if (qq > mq) mq = qq;
        }
      }
      int64_t p[ATT_S];
      int64_t sm = 0;
      int64_t gmax_arr[GROUPS_S];                                // fused group-max: capture per-group max IN the iexp pass
      for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {                       // (group-nested, register-scalar gmax) -> removes the
        int64_t gmax = 0;                                        // separate 16384-elem max scan. Output bit-identical.
        for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++) { int64_t pv = mx_iexp(q[j] - mq); p[j] = pv; sm += pv; if (pv > gmax) gmax = pv; }
        gmax_arr[g] = gmax;
      }
      int ls = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)sm);
      uint64_t inv_sm = (((uint64_t)1 << (ls + MX_FRAC)) + ((uint64_t)sm >> 1)) / (uint64_t)sm;   // one rounded reciprocal/row
      for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
        int64_t gmax = gmax_arr[g];
        if (gmax == 0) { P_scales[g][i] = 0; for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++) P_q[i][j] = 0; continue; }
        // group e8m0 scale so the group-max lands at ~2^MX_P_TARGET_LOG2 (moderate; avoids e4 overflow)
        int e = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)gmax) - ls - MX_P_TARGET_LOG2;
        P_scales[g][i] = (uint8_t)(e + 127);
        for (int j = g * 32; j < (g + 1) * 32; j++) P_q[i][j] = mx_ienc_fp8(p[j], inv_sm, ls, e);
      }
    }

    // ---- 4) O = P @ V on Gemmini (bf16 out) ----
    {
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&P_scales, sizeof(P_scales), 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)V_sc, VSS_BYTES, 1);
      
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < p_v_tiles_I; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < p_v_tiles_K; k += 2) { 
          int bb = (p_v_tiles_K - k < 2) ? (p_v_tiles_K - k) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)P_q) + i * DIM * ATT_S + k * DIM),
                                p_v_a_base + (i * p_v_tiles_K + k) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM); 
        }
      }
      
      gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t));   // B=V[S][D] stride N=D -> slot (k*tiles_J+j)
      for (int k = 0; k < p_v_tiles_K; k++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < p_v_tiles_J; j += 2) { 
          int bb = (p_v_tiles_J - j < 2) ? (p_v_tiles_J - j) : 2;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)V_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_D + j * DIM),
                                p_v_b_base + (k * p_v_tiles_J + j) * DIM, bb * DIM, DIM); 
        }
      }
      
      gemmini_config_st(D_OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, p_v_tiles_I, p_v_tiles_J, p_v_tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(p_v_tiles_I, p_v_tiles_J, p_v_tiles_K, 0, 0, 0, p_v_a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                           p_v_dest, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
      gemmini_mx_read_smem(&O_hw[h][0][0], p_v_dest * 16, ATT_S * ATT_D);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
